retain_full_lhs.mechanism: checked full-K LHS retention for multi-M-tile blocks
retain_full_lhs.note: Raw i32 or scalar native i8, no bias; original-view capacity and repeated-load guards; other classes preserve the incumbent.

pipeline_max_m_blocks.mechanism: checked dense K=1 capacity-limited M block alternative
pipeline_max_m_blocks.note: Incumbent8; opt-in16 reuses the selected ACC/operand capacity checks and per-K drains. No shape class promoted.

conv_output_rows.mechanism: checked rolling convolution spatial output groups
conv_output_rows.note: Bound source-row grouping by ACC and ring capacity; every original source output, tail and final drain remains.

conv_bank_separation.mechanism: capacity-checked placement of full resident convolution RHS at a bank boundary
conv_bank_separation.note: Only when the complete RHS still fits after the private rolling input; otherwise preserve maximal capacity placement.
